title: David Becomes King
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who keeps looking until the treasure turns up, and tonight David is crowned after years of waiting: Scout waters a bean seed morning after morning until the first green curl appears.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a seeker knows some treasures take time to find. In Scout’s world today: Scout plants a bean seed in a paper cup and wants it to sprout right now. Every morning Scout looks, and every morning there is only dirt. Scout keeps watering and keeps waiting. Then one morning a tiny green curl pokes up, and Scout shouts for the whole family to come and see. Just like David waiting so many years to become king, Scout discovered that the best things are worth waiting for.
